Freelance writer Kazuma meets Misaki for the first time in ten years at a high school reunion. After hearing about her dead bedroom situation, he jumps on the chance to bed her under the guise of a "concerned friend." They start out at a love hotel but things quickly progress to secret dates and rendezvous, even creeping into Misaki's own home.
